description: Annotation schema for Learner State Inferrer (LSI) labels on MathDial student turns. Supports both distantly-supervised labels (from MathDial expert fields via LLM classification) and gold labels (hand-annotated).

annotation_id.description: UUID assigned by the labeling pipeline.

dialogue_id.description: Source dialogue_id from MathDial preprocessed data.

turn_idx.description: Index of the student turn within its dialogue.

student_text.description: The full text of the student turn being labeled.

context_window.description: The previous up-to-4 turns shown alongside the student turn.

confusion_type.description: Dominant type of confusion for this turn.

misconception_flag.description: 1 if the turn reveals a stable wrong mental model, 0 otherwise.

annotation_round.description: 1 for first pass; 2 for self-consistency re-annotation (gold only).
